subtasks: Lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor according to the image on the board, pick it up, and place it into the basket.
Transfer the raised level basket handle from the right gripper to the left gripper. Keep the right grip until the left has secured the handle.
Keep the basket raised and level in the left gripper. Use the right gripper to pick the white remote control matching the display from the conveyor and release it fully inside the basket.
